decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the mobile classroom hereby permitted shall be in keeping with those used in the main school building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith (PC 11 21/01, PC 11 21/02, PC 11 21/03 received 20.05.11.) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - "Before the development hereby permitted commences the applicant must either:
a.	Investigate the site for landfill gas to the satisfaction of the LPA, to ascertain whether gas protection measures are required.  Where measures are required the details shall be submitted to, and approved by, the LPA.
Or;
b.	The applicant shall install gas protection measures as a precautionary measure without first investigating the site.  The details of these measures shall be submitted to, and approved by, the LPA.
c.	For a. and b. all required measures shall be installed before the development is first occupied.

Condition : 5 - The building hereby permitted shall be removed and the land restored to its former condition on or before 15.07.14 in accordance with a scheme of work submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.

Reason. So as not to be detrimental to the visual amenities of the area owing to the building becoming dilapidated by reason of the temporary nature of the material used in its construction, and the type of building is not such as the Council is prepared to approve, other than for a limited period, in view of its appearance.
description: Erection of a single storey mobile classroom.
